violations.why: The ISR can overwrite v_amber between the task's write and its read-back, so the task reads 0x09 instead of the 0x01 it wrote.
The ISR can change v_amber between the first and second reads, so the two reads in the same expression see different values.
The ISR can change v_amber between the second and third reads, so the two reads see different values.
